dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: May 2026: Record 14-Launch Month Closes — 67 Missions in 2026; 618th Booster Recovery; IPO Roadshow 4 Days Away
heroSubtitle: 8,790 days since SpaceX founding — May 2026 became the most active launch month in company history with 14 orbital missions including Starship IFT-12 Block 3 (May 22) and the 50th dedicated Starlink mission of the year (Starlink 17-41, May 30, Vandenberg SLC-4E, 15:25 UTC). Booster B1082 (22nd flight) landed on 'Of Course I Still Love You' for OCISLY's 199th touchdown and the 618th cumulative SpaceX booster recovery. SpaceX has now completed 67 orbital missions in 2026 with 10,534+ active Starlink satellites and 10.3M subscribers. The Nasdaq (SPCX) IPO management roadshow begins in 4 days (June 4–8), with pricing June 11 and debut June 12 targeting a $75–80B raise at an implied $1.75–2T valuation. Starship remains grounded pending FAA mishap investigation into IFT-12's Booster 19 boostback anomaly (resolution expected late June 2026); Booster 20 + Ship 40 continue integration at Starbase for IFT-13 targeting July–August 2026.
